questions.question: The average of 9 numbers is 51. Average of three of them is 49 and average of four of the remaimng numbers is 46. What is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 9 numbers is 51.

The average of three of them is 49.

And the average of 4 of the remaining numbers is 46.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 9 numbers average = 51

Now, out of 9, 3 numbers average = 49

It means, 51 - 49 = 2 (Remained from the total average)

Now, average for next 4 numbers = 46

It means, 51 - 46 = 5 (Remained from the total average)

Therefore, Average of remaining 2 numbers,

⇒ (2 × 3) + (5 × 4) + (2 × 51)/2

⇒ 6 + 20 + 102/2 

⇒ 128/2 = 64

∴ The average of the remaining numbers is 64.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of the observations) / (Number of observations)

**Calculation:**

The average of 9 numbers is 51.

Sum of 9 numbers = 9 × 51 = 459

The average of three of them is 49.

Sum of 3 numbers = 3 × 49 = 147

And the average of 4 of the remaining numbers is 46.

Sum of 4 numbers = 4 × 46 = 184

The sum of the remaining numbers = 459 – (147 + 184) = 128

The average of the remaining numbers = 128over(9-7) = 128over2 = 64

**∴ The average of the remaining numbers is 64.**

questions.question: ₹16,000 is lent out for 2 years at 20% compound interest per annum. If the interest had been compounded half yearly instead of compounded annually, then ₹x more would have been earned as interest. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principle = 16000

Time = 2 years

Rate = 20%

If rate is six monthly then rate is increased in the form of x

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

A = CI + P

**Calculation:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

A = 16000(1 + 20/100)²

⇒ A = 23040 

CI = A - P

⇒ CI = 23040 - 16000 

⇒ CI = 7040

Now, if rate is six monthly

R = {20over 2}\% = 10%

T = 2 × 2 = 4 years

Now, 

A = 16000(1 + 10/100)4

⇒ A = 23425.6

CI = A - P 

⇒ CI = 23425.6 - 16000 

⇒ CI = 7425.6

Now, 

x = 7425.6 - 7040 

⇒ x = 385.60

**∴ The increased compound interest, x = Rs. 385.60**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

If rate is annually,

⇒ 16000 × 20% = 3200 × 2 = 6400

⇒ 3200 × 20% = 640 × 1 = 640

CI = 6400 + 640 = 7040

If rate is six monthly

⇒ 16000 × 10% = 1600 × 4 = 6400

⇒1600 × 10% = 160 × 6 = 960

⇒ 160 × 10% = 16 × 4 = 64

⇒ 16 × 10% = 1.6 × 1 = 1.6

CI = 6400 + 960 + 64 + 1.6 

⇒ CI = 7425.6

x = 7425.6 - 7040

⇒ x = 385.6

∴ The increased compound interest = x = Rs. 385.60

questions.question: The area of a rectangular garden is 432 m². The perimeter (in m) of the rectangular garden whose length is 6 m more then its width is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of rectangular garden = 432 m²

Length is 6 m more than width

**Concept: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9571503348d56e1a558390dee6f3663d2bfeabb063acd87cd4f16b6c038506cf.png] 

Area of rectangular park = width × length

Perimeter of rectangular park = 2 (w + l)

**Calculation: **

Let, width of the rectangular Garden = w

then, length of the rectangular garden = w + 6

Area = w × (w + 6) = 432

⇒ w² + 6w - 432 = 0

⇒ w² + 24w - 18w - 432 = 0 

⇒ w (w + 24) - 18 (w + 24) = 0

⇒ (w + 24) (w - 18) = 0

So, w = 18 and w = - 24 (not possible, width can not be -ve)

So Width is 18 and length is 18 + 6 = 24

perimeter of the rectangular garden = 2 (w + l) 

perimeter = 2 (24 + 18) = 2 × 42 = 84

**∴ The perimeter of the rectangular park is 84 m.**

questions.question: The HCF of 552, 759, and 828 is x. The value of x lies between:
questions.solution:

Prime factors of 552 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 23 = 8 × 69

Prime factor of 759 = 3 × 11 × 23 = 11 × 69

The highest common factor of 552, 759, and 828 is 69.

questions.question: Anil left from city Y for city X at 4.20 am. He traveled at the speed of 70 km/h for the first 1h 30 min. After that, the speed was reduced to 50 km/h. If the distance between the two cities was 240 km, then at what time did Anil reach city X?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 240 km

S ₁ = 70 km/h

S ₂ = 50 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation;**

Anil travels from Y city to X city in 1 h 30 min with speed = 70 km

Distance covered by Anil in 1 h 30 min = Speed × Time

⇒ 70 × (1 + 30/60) hr

⇒ 70 × 3/2 = 105 km

Remaining distance = 240 - 105 = 135 km

Time required to cover the remaining distance = 135/50 hr

Total time taken by Anil to reach on X city = 1 hr 30 min + 2 hr 42 min

⇒ 4 hr 12 min

So Anil reached at X city on = 4:20 am + 4 hr 12 min

⇒ 8:32 am

**∴ The required answer is 8:32 am.**

questions.question: Kelvin and Kin can together finish work in 25 days. They worked together for 15 days and then Kin left. After that, Kelvin finished the remaining work in 12 days. In how many days, can Kelvin alone finish the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Kelvin and Kin together = 25 days

Kin left after 15 days

Kelvin finished the remaining work in 12 days

**Formula used:**

Work Done = time × efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let kelvin and kin be A and B respectively-

⇒ A + B = 25 Days

⇒ 1 Day Work by A and B = 1/A + 1/B

⇒ 1/A + 1/B = 1/25

According to Question -

⇒ (1/A + 1/B) ×15 + 1/A × 12 = 1

⇒ 1/25 × 15 + 1/A × 12 =1

⇒ 1/A × 12 = 1 - 15/25

⇒ A = large{(25 × 12)/(10)} 

⇒ A = 30 Days

∴ The correct answer is 30.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

According to question,

Time taken by Kelvin and Kin together = 25 days

Kin left after 15 days

Kelvin finished the remaining work in 12 days

So, (Kelvin + kin) × 25 = (Kelvin + Kin) × 15 + Kelvin × 12

⇒ 25 Kelvin + 25 Kin = 27 Kelvin + 15 Kin

⇒ 10 Kin = 2 Kelvin

⇒ Kin/Kelvin = 1/5

Total Work = (Kin + Kelvin) × 25 = 6 × 25 = 150

Time taken by Kelvin alone = 150/5 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

questions.question: 4 years ago, the average age of a family of 4 members was 19 years. A baby having been born, the average age of the family is the same today. Find the present age of the baby.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Present average age of 4 older members = 19 + 4 = 23 years.

Total age of these 4 members today = 23 × 4 = 92 years.

Total age of 5 members today (including baby) = 19 × 5 = 95 years.

Present age of the baby = 95 − 92 = 3 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of a family of 4 members 4 years ago = 19 years

Current average age of the family (5 members including baby) = 19 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of Persons

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 4 members 4 years ago = 4 × 19 = 76 years

⇒ After 4 years, each member's age increases by 4 years.

⇒ Total increase in age of 4 members = 4 × 4 = 16 years

⇒ Present total age of the 4 original members = 76 + 16 = 92 years

⇒ Total members in the family today = 4 + 1 (baby) = 5 members

⇒ Present total age of 5 members = 5 × 19 = 95 years

⇒ Present age of the baby = Total present age of 5 members − Total present age of 4 members

⇒ Present age of the baby = 95 − 92 = 3 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Change in Average over Time

If the average age of a group is A years, then after t years, the new average age of the same group becomes (A + t) years, provided no member leaves or joins.

Inclusion of a New Member

Age of new member = Total age of new group − Total age of old group at present. This is frequently used when a baby is born or a new person joins a group.

Combined Average

The combined average of two groups with sizes n₁ and n₂ and averages A₁ and A₂ respectively is given by (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

questions.question: A can complete a task in 15 days and B can do it in 20 days. What is their one day work together?
questions.solution:
**Given;**

A can complete a task in 15 days.

B can complete a task in 20 days.

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 15 and 20 = 60

Total work = 60 units

Efficiency of A = 60/15 = 4

Efficiency of B = 60/20 = 3

Together A and B work taken time = 60/(4 + 3)

⇒ 60/7

Work done is inversely proportional to time taken.

**∴ Work done together by A and B = 7/60**

questions.question: If A bought an item for ₹384 and sold for ₹527, and B bought another item for ₹1,264 and sold for ₹1,724, whose gain percentage is more and by how much approximately?
questions.solution:

Cost price of A is 384

Selling Price A is 527

**∴ Gain percentage of A is 0.84 % more than B.**

questions.question: The diameter of the base of a right circular cone is 60 cm its height is 16 cm. The curved surface area(in cm²) of the cone is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diameter of the base of a right circular cone = 60 cm

The height of a right circular cone = 16 cm

**Formula used:**

The curved surface area of the cone = π × (radius) × (slant height)

(Slant height)² = (radius)² + (height)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16172c5909bd2dbf449f4c35f376a9b53f237df233d0daa82e762852c2fae84d.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let, diameter = D

Radius = R

⇒ R = D/2 = 60/2 = 30 cm

(Slant height)2 = (radius)2 + (height)2

Slant height = sqrt {R² + H²}

Slant height = sqrt {30² + 16² } 

⇒ sqrt { 900 + 256 }

⇒ sqrt { 1156}

⇒ 34

Now, The curved surface area of the cone = π × (radius) × (slant height)

⇒ π × 30 × 34

⇒ 1020 π 

**∴ The curved surface area (in cm2) of the cone is 1020 π **
